title: Carry plan revisions through VS Code commands
description: Objective: provide the secondary IDE wire bridge after the JetBrains reviewed-dialog child task-247fdf296ff2445daae8e057c0608f51. Deliverable: moe-vscode/src/types/moe.ts adds legacy-compatible Task.planRevision and optional expectedPlanRevision on the APPROVE_TASK message type; src/services/MoeDaemonClient.ts accepts and forwards an explicitly supplied nonnegative safe-integer revision unchanged. Omit the key for omitted arguments, including all unchanged old callers; never replace a supplied revision with currentState. Guard malformed supplied input against silent no-field fallback, preserve boolean disconnected send result. Extend the existing onError payload additively to preserve daemon top-level operation/code/codeName and safe context.taskId/revision fields, accepting old payload-nested format too; this gives the rendered panel correlated stale-refusal feedback. Own new tests/plan-approval-client.test.cjs using node:test and the existing TypeScript transpileModule/VM mocking convention to execute production client code. Scope is these 3 files only. Also depends on task-c6e2eca5e19f4aaf9323f02aefadb29a to serialize shared VS Code model work. NOT in scope: webview click/render logic, changing all legacy board/detail callers, daemon policy or JetBrains. Exact gate at repo root on Windows: cmd /d /c "npm --prefix moe-vscode test && npm --prefix moe-vscode run compile"; Unix: npm --prefix moe-vscode test && npm --prefix moe-vscode run compile. Require nonzero node:test counts and focused red-on-old evidence.

Invalid supplied token is refused without an outbound legacy command; disconnected/send-error behavior is preserved and tested with no false success.
Task snapshots preserve planRevision through the existing client state update path without discarding legacy missing fields; compile verifies type compatibility with unchanged callers.

onError preserves both modern top-level and old nested operation fields and safe mismatch code/task context; tests prove unrelated or unallowlisted error context is not promoted into the public payload.
Fresh VS Code npm test and npm run compile exit 0 with nonzero test counts, and the new serialization/refusal regression fails on old code.
